Class FilteringDependencyTransitiveNodeVisitor

java.lang.Object
org.owasp.dependencycheck.maven.FilteringDependencyTransitiveNodeVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.maven.shared.dependency.graph.traversal.DependencyNodeVisitor
public class FilteringDependencyTransitiveNodeVisitor extends Object implements org.apache.maven.shared.dependency.graph.traversal.DependencyNodeVisitor
A dependency node visitor that filters nodes and their children and delegates to another visitor.
